title: Finite normalized Koszul coefficient cone identification
statement: Let C,J,A,I,b be the small-site coefficient data [def-sfb-constant-completion-coefficient-data]. Suppose an additive exact functor E:ModuleCat A -> Mod O_b is supplied, together with a regular-module isomorphism c and finite-quotient isomorphisms q_n satisfying the scalar and quotient-unit equations in [lem-r1-constant-exact-coefficient-realization]. Let a:Fin r -> A generate I, and let epsilonA_n, tA_nm, qA_nm be exterior Koszul augmentations and diagonal/quotient transitions with the explicit degree-component formulas and strict augmentation squares [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-koszul-augmentation-pro-zero], without assuming the pro-zero conclusion. Set U=O_b[0]. For every map v from the strict Koszul tensor tower at U to the reduction tower at U which preserves the actual ordinary-limit unit [lem-u4-constant-koszul-quotient-augmentation], the realized finite algebraic augmentation cone at n is isomorphic to the level n cone of v. The isomorphisms commute with every n<=m transition as in the attached Lean statement. No Noetherianity, arbitrary complex P, K-flatness, eventual vanishing or derived inverse limit is asserted.

proof.text: Apply exteriorKoszul_scalar_realization to the supplied exact functor and regular module normalization. It identifies the realized extended exterior complex with the actual dual Koszul tower, including every diagonal transition and the degree-zero unit.

The left tensor unitor identifies U tensor the dual complex with the dual complex. The strict tower complex is reconstructed by CochainComplex.of; use its identity-component natural isomorphism with the original total complex before inserting the unitor. The singleMapHomologicalComplex and scalar-extension regular-module unit isomorphisms identify the reduction of U with the finite quotient in degree zero. Compose with q_n for the target comparison.

Project the stated ordinary-limit unit equation to level n, then take degree zero. The limit.lift projection formula gives the actual strict tensor-unit equation. Precompose by c followed by the realization of the exterior degree-zero basis map. The exterior unit normalization and naturality of the tensor unitors turn the source into the actual Koszul unit. On the target, the reduction unit sends 1 to 1 tensor 1, and the scalar-extension unit comparison multiplies this to the section 1. The supplied q_n normalization is the same map. Every other target degree is zero, so degree zero determines the augmentation square. Its algebraic augmentation is degreewise epi: in degree zero it is a quotient after an isomorphism, elsewhere its target is zero. Exact E preserves epimorphy.

Apply additiveConeFamilyComparison with these source and target isomorphisms. Source naturality is already supplied by exterior realization; epimorphy of each augmentation forces target naturality. The additive cone comparison then supplies exactly the displayed cone isomorphisms and their strict naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem constantKoszulCoefficientConeComparison
    (b : Bool)
    (E : ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤ Mod (coefficients J A I b)) [E.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits E] [PreservesFiniteColimits E]
    (c : SheafOfModules.unit (siteModuleRings (coefficients J A I b)) ≅
      E.obj (ModuleCat.of A A))
    (q : ∀ n : ℕ, E.obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1))) ≅
      (res (finiteMap J A I b n)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (siteModuleRings (finite J A I n))))
    (hs : ∀ x : A, c.hom ≫ E.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mul A A x)) =
      ringedKoszulScalar (coefficients J A I b) (algebraSection (baseMap J A I b) x) ≫
        c.hom)
    (hq : ∀ n : ℕ, c.hom ≫ E.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (I ^ (n + 1)).mkQ) ≫ (q n).hom =
      (SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv
        ((res (finiteMap J A I b n)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (siteModuleRings (finite J A I n))))).symm
        ⟨fun V ↦ (1 : (finite J A I n).obj.obj V),
          fun f ↦ map_one ((finite J A I n).obj.map f).hom⟩)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = I)
    (εA : ∀ n : ℕ, ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun i ↦ a i ^ (n + 1)) ⟶
      (ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ (Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (n + 1))))
    (tA : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m →
      (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun i ↦ a i ^ (m + 1)) ⟶
        ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun i ↦ a i ^ (n + 1))))
    (qA : ∀ n m : ℕ, n ≤ m →
      ((ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ (Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (m + 1))) ⟶
        (ChainComplex.single₀ (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ (Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (n + 1)))))
    (hεA : ∀ n, (εA n).f 0 = ModuleCat.ofHom
      (((Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (n + 1)).mkQ.comp
        (exteriorPower.zeroEquiv A (Fin r →₀ A)).toLinearMap))
    (htA : ∀ n m h k, (tA n m h).f k = ModuleCat.ofHom
      (exteriorPower.map k
        (Finsupp.linearCombination A (fun i ↦ Finsupp.single i (a i ^ (m - n))))))
    (hqA : ∀ n m h,
      ModuleCat.ofHom ((Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (m + 1)).mkQ ≫ (qA n m h).f 0 =
        ModuleCat.ofHom ((Ideal.span (Set.range a)) ^ (n + 1)).mkQ)
    (hc : ∀ n m h,
      HomologicalComplex.extendMap (tA n m h) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ≫
        HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA n) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat =
      HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA m) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ≫
        HomologicalComplex.extendMap (qA n m h) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat) :
    let O := coefficients J A I b
    let U := ringedSiteRingComplex O
    ∀ (v : (ringedKoszulTensorTowerFunctor O r
        (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap J A I b) (a i))).obj U ⟶
      ((reductionTower J A I b).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj U)
      (_hv : ringedKoszulLimitUnit O r
        (fun i ↦ algebraSection (baseMap J A I b) (a i)) U ≫
          (ordinaryLimit O).map v = ordinaryUnit J A I b U),
    ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA n) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)) ≅
          (CochainComplex.mappingCone v).asFunctor.obj (op n),
      ∀ (n m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
        (E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          (HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.mapArrowHom
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA m) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
            (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (εA n) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
            (fun j : ℤ ↦ ⟨j - 1, sub_add_cancel j 1⟩)
            (Arrow.homMk
              (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (tA n m h) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
              (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (qA n m h) ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
              (hc n m h))) ≫ (e n).hom =
        (e m).hom ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCone v).asFunctor.map
          (homOfLE h).op
